claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: SB-415286 is a selective, ATP-competitive GSK-3 inhibitor that at 2.5 uM is expected to cause little or no direct cytotoxicity, with any antiproliferative effect likely reflecting GSK-3-dependent modulation of proliferation, mitotic exit, or survival signaling rather than a general cytotoxic insult.
